Strongest in 10 years:
Mag 5.5
On Nov 15, 2017 14:29.
Strongest since 1900:
Mag 6.4
On Mar 19, 1952 18:04.
The strongest recent earthquake of the past 10 years near Seoul occurred on Nov 15, 2017 14:29 local time (Asia/Seoul timezone). It had a magnitude of 5.5 and struck
 264 kilometers (164 mi) south-east of Seoul, at a depth of 10 km. Discover more strong earthquakes near Seoul in the list below.
A longer time ago, a MAG-6.4 earthquake struck on Mar 19, 1952 18:04, 176 kilometers (109 mi) south-east of Seoul. It is the strongest earthquake near Seoul in the past 126 years (Our data goes back to January 1st, 1900).

Map of Nearest Earthquakes from Seoul
Frequently Asked Questions
These questions are commonly asked in relation to earthquakes occurring near Seoul.
When was the last earthquake in Seoul?
A 3.6 magnitude earthquake hit near Seoul on the evening of November 17, 2026 at 23:10 local time (Asia/Seoul). The center of this earthquake was located 145km south-east of Seoul at a depth of 20km under land. Check the list on our website for any earthquakes occurring near Seoul in the past hours.
What was the strongest earthquake near Seoul?
A 6.4 magnitude earthquake hit near Seoul on the evening of March 19, 1952 at 18:04 local time (Asia/Seoul). The center of this earthquake was located 176km northwest of Seoul at a depth of 35km under land. This is the strongest earthquake that occurred near Seoul since the year 1900.
How often do earthquakes occur near Seoul?
In the past 10 years, 6 earthquakes with a magnitude of four or higher occurred within a 300 kilometer range from Seoul. This averages to 1 earthquakes yearly, or one earthquake every 608 days.
